data.narrative:
CX2 Industries is a Series A-stage defense & security company founded by Nathan Mintz and Porter Smith that has raised $46M to date. Valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 10 peers: 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Stark Defence, Castelion, Singularity, and NODA AI, all operating in the same sector and stage.

Two triangulation methods were applied. The stage-progression method uses total capital raised as a proxy base ($46M) and applies a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A advancement, implying a $92M valuation. The peer-median approach surveys four same-sector, same-stage comparables with valuations ranging from $125M (NODA AI) to $4.0B (Stark Defence). The median across these four peers is $700M, reflecting substantial dispersion within the defense & security segment.

The triangulated analysis across both methods produces a valuation range of $78M (low) to $805M (high), with a median of $396M. The wide range reflects material uncertainty around where CX2 sits within the peer distribution—whether it aligns with lower-quartile peers like NODA AI or approaches upper-quartile multiples. Stage-progression anchors conservatively, while peer-median sensitivity to outliers (particularly Stark Defence at $4.0B) significantly widens the band. Capital efficiency, technology differentiation within defense applications, and customer concentration represent key drivers of positioning within this range.
